name: Autotask Contract Services and Recurring Billing
description: The recurring-billing side of Autotask contracts: service and bundle lines (autotask_search_contract_services, autotask_search_contract_service_bundles), the billed unit rows behind them (autotask_search_contract_service_units, autotask_search_contract_service_bundle_units), the per-contract monthly recurring-revenue roll-up (autotask_get_contract_recurring_lines), and writing service lines and onboarding contract shells.
